scams.name: Gohtong Jaya 'Wild Fish / Market Price' Seafood Bill-Shock at Genting Food Street
scams.description: At Loong Kee Restaurant in Gohtong Jaya, a server waves you toward a tank of 'fresh wild-caught patin' — 'sikit mahal sahaja,' just a bit pricey. No menu, no written quote. The fish is steamed, weighed post-killing, and the bill arrives: RM902 for 2.7 kg at RM338/kg. NST 'Genting Highlands restaurant under probe over RM902 patin dish' (March 2026) names the case; KPDN opened a formal probe, and Mothership SG logged another Singaporean family at RM1,762. Demand the printed menu before ordering, refuse 'market price' without a written RM/kg quote and a live weigh-in, and walk if staff insist on weighing post-steam.
scams.avoidance: Demand printed menu with prices BEFORE ordering; photograph every page NEVER accept 'market price' / 'wild catch' without written RM/kg + estimated weight Skip wild patin buah, soon hock, grouper, abalone unless you watched live weigh-in Pay by credit card for chargeback leverage; photograph menu + dish as evidence KPDN hotline 1-800-886-800 or ez-ADU app for overcharge complaints
scams.location: Gohtong Jaya food street (Loong Kee Restaurant, Jalan Lau Ko Lin), SkyAvenue mall casual-dining zone, First World Plaza seafood stalls, Chin Swee Caves Temple roadside restaurants, Resorts World Genting Chinese fine-dining outlets

scams.name: Fake Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park Tickets & QR-Code Reseller Scam
scams.description: On Facebook Marketplace someone offers a Genting SkyWorlds day pass for RM110 — well below the RM183 gate price, with an urgent-sale story ('can't go, already paid'). The PDF or QR they send is single-use or issued under another name; at the gate the scanner flashes red. Resorts World Genting's #TakNakScam advisories and rwgenting.com/en/daily-notice/fake-websites-alert.html name the cloned-domain family (gentinghotel-resort.com, rwgenting-booking.com). Book only at gentingskyworlds.com or rwgenting.com — no hyphens, no -booking suffix — or via Klook/KKday with the 'Official' badge. For same-day tickets there is no legitimate reseller scenario.
scams.avoidance: Book SkyWorlds tickets ONLY at gentingskyworlds.com, rwgenting.com, Klook, or KKday Refuse every Facebook / Carousell / WhatsApp / Shopee 'private sale' or 'discount reseller' Verify email is @rwgenting.com or @gentingskyworlds.com; pay by credit card NEVER scan QR codes posted in comments or sent by strangers NSRC hotline 997 within 24 hours if scammed; MOTAC #TakNakScam 1-300-88-5050
scams.location: Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park main gate, SkyAvenue mall ticket counter, First World Plaza concourse, online (Facebook Marketplace, Carousell, Shopee, Lazada), Awana SkyWay lower terminal
scams.tldr: Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park tickets are Malaysia's most-impersonated attraction inventory.

scams.name: Resorts World Genting Fake 'Hotel Staff' Room-Phone & OTP/Card-Verification Fraud
scams.description: You check into First World Hotel and the in-room phone rings within an hour. 'Front desk, sir — your card was declined, can you confirm the number and CVV?' Or an SMS arrives: 'Resorts World Reservations — click to confirm your stay / pay a re-confirmation fee.' Resorts World's own advisory is blunt: 'Resorts World Genting will never call you to obtain your OTP or password for any reason.' The Star reported in January 2026 that MCMC shut down an illegal transceiver sending the phishing SMS batches at Genting. Hang up, walk to the front desk in person, and ignore every 'verification' link. Book only at rwgenting.com (no hyphens) or Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com.
scams.avoidance: NEVER give card / CVV / OTP / password over hotel room phone; walk to front desk Book rooms ONLY at rwgenting.com (no hyphens) or Agoda/Booking.com/Trip.com Ignore every 'confirmation fee' SMS; Resorts World never charges beyond reservation Refuse 'cheap member room' Facebook/WhatsApp offers — keycards get cancelled by 4 PM NSRC 997 within 24 hours; Resorts World Auxiliary Police +603-2718 1118
scams.location: First World Hotel, Genting Grand Hotel, Resorts World Awana, Crockfords Hotel, SkyAvenue check-in lobby, online (fake booking domains), Facebook Marketplace, WhatsApp / SMS phishing

scams.name: SkyCasino Distraction Chip-Lift & Casino-Floor Begging-Syndicate Scam
scams.description: At a Sic Bo table on the SkyCasino floor, a friendly stranger settles beside you and starts chatting about lucky numbers. A second person bumps past, jacket draped over your tray. By the time you look down, chips have been palmed. AsiaOne / Stomp logged the May 2025 arrest of four foreign nationals at Resorts World Genting for organized begging-and-lift activity; The Star reported 152 Genting-adjacent arrests the same month. A parallel layer: women approach elderly gamblers with 'I lost all my money, can you buy me food?' Treat every chatty stranger at a table as a team member, never leave chips unattended, and refuse every 'cash for chips' loan-shark offer.
scams.avoidance: Treat chatty slot-neighbors as potential teams; move if someone sits beside you NEVER leave chips unattended; stack in dominant-hand pocket when stepping away Refuse every 'buy me food / lost all my money' approach — they are syndicated Never hand Genting Rewards card to anyone; use cashier cage only, not strangers Auxiliary Police on casino floor for suspicious approaches; CCTV review via Pit Boss
scams.location: SkyCasino main floor, Casino de Genting (original casino), Sic Bo tables, slot-machine banks, First World Plaza casino concourse, SkyAvenue mall food court entry points

scams.name: KL–Genting Unlicensed Shuttle-Van 'Souvenir Stop' & Upsell Scam
scams.description: In a Bukit Bintang hotel lobby, a 'tour operator' offers a KL–Genting day trip for RM120 per person, cable car included. The van is unlicensed, the cable-car ticket is upsold for another RM40 at Awana, and the route detours 30 minutes through a Bentong batik factory and chocolate outlet where the driver earns 10–20% commission. The June 2024 AsiaOne report on a Genting tour-bus fatality flagged the 'driver had no license' pattern. The official Genting Express bus from KL Sentral or TBS runs RM10–RM20 round-trip and includes the Awana SkyWay — book at rwgenting.com or the KL Sentral Aerobus counter. A Grab the whole way is RM120–RM180 for the vehicle, not per person.
scams.avoidance: Use OFFICIAL Genting Express bus from KL Sentral or TBS: RM10 one-way, RM20 return with cable car Grab / MyCar KL–Genting is RM120–RM180 per vehicle, not per person — compare first Refuse every hotel-lobby 'tour van'; verify agency at motac.gov.my/semakan Explicitly refuse 'souvenir stops' — get 'direct route' written on receipt JPJ 1-800-88-7723 or tourist police 03-2149 6590
scams.location: KL Sentral Aerobus Genting Express terminal, Bukit Bintang hotel lobbies, KLCC pickup points, Terminal Bersepadu Selatan (TBS), Terminal Bersepadu Gombak (TBG), Bentong toll plaza souvenir-stop layover, Awana SkyWay lower terminal

scams.name: ATM DCC 'Home-Currency Conversion' Markup at Resorts World & Gohtong Jaya
scams.description: You insert a foreign Visa at a Maybank ATM in First World Plaza. The screen prompts 'Convert to USD? Rate: 1 USD = 4.72 MYR' with the 'Accept' button styled to favor it — the interbank rate is around 4.25, so the markup is roughly 11%. A RM1,000 withdrawal locks in USD235.85 instead of the USD212 your card's network would have delivered, plus a separate RM12–RM24 'convenience fee.' Wise and Visa Malaysia confirm the 3–7% DCC markup pattern; the Malaysia-Safe advisory (malaysiasafe.app/safety/scams/dynamic-currency-conversion) names it. At every ATM in Genting, refuse 'home currency' — press 'Decline conversion' or 'Continue in MYR' and let your bank set the rate. Same at SkyAvenue restaurant POS terminals: insist on 'Pay in MYR.'
scams.avoidance: REFUSE 'home-currency' / 'pay in USD/SGD' prompt — always 'Continue in MYR' Use Maybank or CIMB ATMs inside physical bank branches for transparent prompts At POS, watch screen + insist on 'Pay in MYR'; decline if staff default to home currency Bring a no-FX-fee card (Wise, Revolut, Chase Sapphire, Charles Schwab) Exchange cash at KL Bukit Bintang money changer — Genting rates are 3–5% worse
scams.location: First World Plaza Maybank / CIMB / Public Bank ATMs, SkyAvenue mall Maybank & OCBC ATMs, Gohtong Jaya 7-Eleven and bank-branch ATMs, Genting Premium Outlets RHB ATM, Awana SkyWay lower terminal ATM
